recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Classic Roman pasta with guanciale, eggs, and Pecorino.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil. Salt generously.
Fry guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat.
Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and Pecorino together. Season heavily with black pepper.
Cook spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Add hot pasta to guanciale pan (off heat). Pour egg mixture over, tossing rapidly.
Add pasta water splash by splash until silky and creamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Simple Green Salad
recipes.description: Crisp greens with a classic Dijon vinaigrette.
steps: Whisk together mustard, vinegar, and shallot. Season with salt and pepper.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil, whisking continuously until emulsified.
Toss greens with just enough dressing to coat lightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve immediately.
